title: Storefront View Model v1
description: The one read-only object a kit theme receives (THEME-CONTRACT.md §4). Absent optional keys mean the section is not rendered. Additions beyond §4 are marked in each description with the spec that needs them.

tagline.description: book header tagline; falls back to texts.hero_title

store_type.description: config/verticals.php type, incl. new cafe, grocery, services

accepting_bookings.description: book: false until the owner sets hours (D13)

legal_name.description: registered legal / trading name of the business (core setting fiscal.legal_name)

label.description: server-localised row label, e.g. 'Commercial registration (CR)', 'Trade licence', 'Commercial register'; theme falls back to 'Commercial registration'

commercial_registration.description: commercial registration / trade licence (core setting core.fiscal_cr_number). Carely F3: core blocks publish of a pharmacy store in SA, AE, KW and EG until it is filled

label.description: server-localised row label, e.g. 'VAT number', 'TRN'; theme falls back to 'Tax number'

tax_registration.description: VAT / tax registration number when the store has one (core setting core.fiscal_vat_number); optional everywhere, no publish gate

address.description: registered (legal) address; may differ from contact.address

identity.description: Store identity block (contract §4.1, carely F3): shared by every theme and rendered in the footer when present; each row only when its field is present (no data, no claim). Optional for every store type unless core's per-country checklist requires it (pharmacy stores in SA, AE, KW, EG: legal_name, commercial_registration, address)

seo.description: kit/seo (SEO item 13): what JSON-LD and meta need

schema_type.description: schema.org type, e.g. Restaurant, CafeOrCoffeeShop, GroceryStore, ClothingStore, BeautySalon

returns.description: aisle returns policy (SEO + item info rows)

shipping_rate.description: lowest standard shipping rate (Google merchant listing)

prep_time_min.description: brew §2 ready-time chip; null hides it

staff.description: book §6; absent when staff choice is off

show_identity.description: Show the store identity block (contract §4.1) in the kiosk footer. Per-store setting, default false (owner, 2026-10-03).

offline_queue.description: contract §5.5 / D4: false when any kill switch is on

refunds.description: D7 per-flow switches; themes only change copy

settings.description: resolved Customizer values keyed by field id (kit/<theme>/theme.json)

total.description: large catalogs: total matching items (server search, basket §2, aisle §6)

bnpl.description: D10: present only when the Tabby/Tamara add-on is installed and on

line_note.description: brew §7 (P3-07): present = the item sheet offers the one-line per-line note ("Name on the cup"), printed on the KDS ticket and the receipt; absent = not offered

disclaimer.description: resolved disclaimer text, plain text not HTML

min_age.description: store default minimum age for age-restricted items

legal_name.description: same value as store.identity.legal_name (core fills both from one setting); themes show it once, preferring store.identity

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the licensing country (SA, AE, KW, EG at launch); picks core's per-country checklist (research/pharmacy-licence). Not rendered by the theme

regulator.description: core regulator code, e.g. sa_moh, ae_mohap, ae_dha, ae_doh, kw_moh, eg_eda; core resolves `authority` from it. Not rendered by the theme

label.description: server-localised row label, e.g. 'Commercial registration', 'Trade licence'; theme falls back to 'Commercial registration'

commercial_registration.description: DEPRECATED (carely F3, 2026-10-03): moved to store.identity.commercial_registration. Core no longer fills it and themes ignore it; kept only so the schema stays additive

verify_url.description: regulator register link; optional, rendered only when present (required only where a country rule says so)

logo.description: regulator logo; optional, rendered only when present

registration_no.description: required before publish in every country (carely F2); the theme still renders it only when present

registration_label.description: server-localised label for registration_no, e.g. 'SCFHS no.'; theme falls back to 'Registration :number'

address.description: same value as store.identity.address; themes show it once, preferring store.identity

licence.description: no licence data = no licence claim (the theme renders nothing). Core blocks publish of a pharmacy store until its country's counsel sign-off is recorded (F1), the online-sales approval is uploaded (F6; plus EDA approval in EG, F5) and every field its country checklist requires is filled (carely Q5, F2, F3)

show_expiry.description: DEPRECATED (carely Q8, 2026-10-03): expiry stays internal, no shopper-facing 'Use by' date. Themes ignore it; core no longer fills it

analytics_off.description: always true for pharmacy; core reads it to drop analytics on product, cart, checkout, track and account pages (§8)

pharmacy.description: carely §7 (Tier A): present for pharmacy stores, absent = off. Tier R (features.rx) is NOT in the schema (owner question Q1)

variant.description: P3-07: the last variant (public id), null when none or gone

options.description: P3-07: the last option / add-on public ids that still exist

complete.description: P3-07: every last choice still exists, so the theme may add the line straight to the cart; false = open the item sheet ("Some choices changed")

endpoints.description: named URLs only; themes never build URLs

page.description: Per-page payload. Absent on old fixtures = home. Item sheet, cart, checkout and track data; all money is server-formatted.

meta_label.description: server-formatted duration · price line, e.g. '45 min · SAR 120.00'

age_restricted.description: carely §7 (Tier A): 18+ badge; the server decides, the theme never infers it

pack_label.description: carely §7: server-formatted pack line, e.g. '24 tablets · SAR 0.40 / tablet' (reuses unit.label if that lands first)

promo_allowed.description: carely §7 / rule G4: false = the theme renders no sale/popular/new badge, compare-at price, low-stock urgency or featured placement for this item

expiring_soon.description: DEPRECATED (carely Q8, 2026-10-03): the 'Expires soon' badge is not shown to shoppers; expiry stays internal. Themes ignore it; core no longer fills it

limit_note.description: carely §7: server limit text, e.g. 'Limit 2 packs per order'; quantity.max already exists

estimate_note.description: basket weighed items: estimate + cap text

info_rows.description: delivery date, returns, pick up in store, policy

add_label.description: server-formatted for the default choice, e.g. 'Add · SAR 25.00'; JS re-quotes on change

variants.description: aisle: per-variant sku, price, stock and image for ProductGroup

medicine.description: carely §7: medicine facts, all plain text

leaflet.description: carely §7: patient information leaflet in store media (public, not personal data); null = show the static 'read the leaflet in the pack' text

use_by_label.description: DEPRECATED (carely Q8, 2026-10-03): no shopper-facing 'Use by' date; expiry stays internal. Themes ignore it; core no longer fills it

medicine_text_lang.description: carely Q23 (optional): language code of medicine.dosage and warnings when it differs from the page locale (e.g. 'en' on an Arabic page, because the store gave English only). The theme sets lang/dir on that text and shows the 'Shown in English' note. Absent = same language as the page

age.description: carely §7: age-restricted item; the confirmation travels with the cart line (rule G3)

age_confirmed.description: carely §7: shows '18+ confirmed' on the line

limit_note.description: carely §7: server correction text, e.g. 'Limit 2 per order. We changed the quantity to 2'

amount_label.description: display word instead of the amount, e.g. 'Free' for a zero delivery row; amount stays real Money

informational.description: shown but not summed into total: savings, inclusive tax, estimate caps, deposit / due-later splits (contract §5.2)
